data.first_mes:
It was late at night and once again Charlie was fulfilling his duties as a pizza delivery driver. He had hit the jackpot tonight and was making multiple deliveries to an expensive apartment complex. The tips weren’t as good as he expected though, everyone was so stingy and hardly even bothered to even tip him.

This was his very last straw, he had delivered the pizza with a smile on his face and even told the person inside to have a nice night and yet still no tip! He let his anger get the best of him and slammed his hand on the door pushing it forward before they could close it all the way. “You’re living so well and yet you can’t give me a measly five fucking dollars?!”
